bg-page.$description: Page background of every screen; the base all translucent surfaces are composited over.

bg-page-gradient.$description: Soft accent glow painted over bg-page at the edges of the window.

glass-base.$description: Background of a screen that slides over another (settings, detail); nearly opaque.

glass-card.$description: Card surface (article cards, settings rows, input card); translucent over bg-page.

glass-input.$description: Field surface: inputs, chips, search fields, icon tiles.

glass-border.$description: Edge of glass cards and the input card.

glass-border-strong.$description: Stronger glass edge for floating panels and toasts.

glass-inner-glow.$description: 1px inner highlight at the top of glass surfaces.

surface-bar.$description: Background of fixed bars (pane headers, toolbars) above scrolling content.

outline.$description: Default 1px border of cards, fields, bars and dividers. Decorative (about 1.35:1); a field edge that must be found needs outline-strong (ADR 0005).

text-primary.$description: Body text, titles and icons: the strongest text colour (≥ 14:1 on cards).

text-secondary.$description: Supporting text: labels, descriptions, inactive controls with text.

text-muted.$description: Least important readable text: hints, meta lines, timestamps, placeholders (≥ 4.5:1).

accent.$description: Brand action colour: primary buttons, selected states, links on controls, focus ring, progress.

accent-light.$description: Second stop of the accent gradient (primary button, nav blob, switch on).

on-accent.$description: Text and icons on an accent fill (primary button, selected pill, active nav item).

accent-a05.$description: Accent at 5%: tints for hover, selection and soft borders. Never as text.

accent-a08.$description: Accent at 8%: tints for hover, selection and soft borders. Never as text.
